coverage.scope: All current records and labels indexed; version headers and full-text relationship markers screened. Targeted context review supports the alias groups, repair proposals and typed lineage edges. This is not a cover-to-cover philosophical or source-validity review of the roughly 503,000 extracted words.
coverage.historical_scope: July/August snapshots used to distinguish captured textual states from self-reported version history. Historical-only drafts are retained unchanged and are not relabeled by this proposal.
coverage.external_verification: No live Blogger edits, HTTP link validation, literature review or factual verification of article claims was performed.

alias_groups.rationale: Same field label across competing positions; preserve each article's claims and historical framework.

RCAP and the other tagged posts use information/control concepts; hyphenation does not identify a different field.
Same broad topic across differing ethical arguments; keep metaethics and narrower ethics labels separate.
Expanded forms and abbreviation all denote artificial intelligence in the current assignments. Narrower AI labels remain distinct.
Both posts concern writing and document design; casing does not distinguish their subjects.
Same discipline in RCAP and the persistence-strategy note.
All current assignments concern the erasure principle, not a biographical category. This mapping is limited to this snapshot.
The current uses name the corpus's provisional is/ought boundary. Keep this specific device separate from the broad is-ought problem.

holds.reason: Historical frameworks, concept labels and project/program names are not interchangeable. Keep distinct; retirement of a project name does not erase its historical topic label.
Field/practice and document type overlap but are different axes. Normalize capitalization only; design facets separately.
BCI is a likely abbreviation candidate, but Agent Tomography has a broader measurement scope; do not collapse interface classes or retag article relevance automatically.
Potential broader/narrower relations, not established exact synonyms.
The causal taxonomy note distinguishes classificatory questions. Shared appearance is not enough to collapse terms.
The corpus explicitly distinguishes alignment objectives. Preserve the qualifiers.
The coinage discusses ordinary terrorism as a source concept. Some tags look fragmented, but deleting or merging them needs a separate editorial decision.
Broad concepts, fields and narrower questions should not be conflated merely to reduce the label count.
